title: New Rapid Test Changes Brain Tumour Diagnosis
subtitle: A breakthrough in medical technology is cutting wait times for brain tumour results from months to just two hours.

summary.en: A new rapid test for brain tumours is now being used by the NHS. Developed by the University of Nottingham, the tool provides results in two hours instead of eight weeks. This genomic test analyzes the genetic code of a tumour while a patient is still in surgery. Experts believe this development will save lives by allowing for faster treatment decisions. The NHS is currently piloting the technology in five specialist centres across the UK.
summary.zh: 英國國民保健署目前正使用一種腦瘤快速檢測新工具。該工具由諾丁漢大學開發，能將檢測結果的取得時間從八週縮短至兩小時。這項基因組檢測能在病患手術期間分析腫瘤的基因密碼。專家認為，此項發展能透過加速治療決策來挽救生命。國民保健署目前正在英國境內的五個專科中心試辦這項技術。

paragraphs.en: Doctors are using a new, faster way to identify brain tumours that could change the lives of many patients. The test, which was created by the Brain Tumour Research Centre of Excellence at the University of Nottingham, allows medical teams to get results while a patient is still on the operating table. According to The Guardian Health, this is a major improvement because it reduces the time needed for a diagnosis from eight weeks down to just two hours.
paragraphs.zh: 醫師們正在使用一種能辨識腦瘤的新型快速檢測法，這項技術有望改變許多病患的人生。這項檢測是由諾丁漢大學（University of Nottingham）的腦瘤卓越研究中心所開發，能讓醫療團隊在病患還在手術台上時就取得檢測結果。根據《衛報健康》（The Guardian Health）報導，這是一項重大進展，因為它將診斷所需的時間從八週大幅縮短至僅需兩小時。

paragraphs.en: This development is important because brain tumours are a serious health issue. In the UK, they are the leading cause of cancer deaths for both children and adults under the age of 40. For many patients, time is very limited, and waiting months for test results can be a difficult and stressful experience. By getting answers quickly, doctors can start the right treatment much sooner, which may help save more lives.
paragraphs.zh: 這項發展之所以重要，是因為腦瘤是嚴重的健康問題。在英國，腦瘤是導致兒童及四十歲以下成人癌症死亡的主要原因。對許多病患而言，時間極為寶貴，等待數月才能取得檢測結果是一段艱難且充滿壓力的過程。透過快速取得診斷結果，醫師能更早開始正確的治療，這有助於挽救更多生命。

paragraphs.en: Previously, doctors had to look at tumour samples under a microscope to identify them. This process was often slow and sometimes less precise. The new method uses a genomic test, which means it looks at the genetic code of the tumour. Small pieces of tissue are sent to a lab where they are placed into a special machine made by Oxford Nanopore. Inside this machine, DNA molecules pass through a tiny hole, known as a nanopore. This process reveals the unique genetic makeup of the tumour, giving doctors clear and accurate information very quickly.
paragraphs.zh: 過去，醫師必須透過顯微鏡觀察腫瘤樣本來進行辨識，這個過程通常很緩慢，且有時精確度不足。這項新方法採用基因組檢測，意即分析腫瘤的基因密碼。醫療人員會將小塊組織樣本送往實驗室，放入由牛津奈米孔（Oxford Nanopore）公司製造的特殊儀器中。在儀器內部，去氧核糖核酸（DNA）分子會通過一個稱為「奈米孔」的微小孔洞。此過程能揭示腫瘤獨特的基因組成，讓醫師能迅速獲得清晰且準確的資訊。

paragraphs.en: Stuart Smith, a consultant neurosurgeon at Nottingham University Hospitals NHS Trust, helped lead the research team. He explained that having this detailed information while a patient is still in surgery is a game-changing moment for medicine. He noted that he is very proud of the team’s work, especially because it helps patients who do not have much time to wait for answers. This speed also means that some patients might be able to join clinical trials—which are special research studies to test new treatments—much earlier than before.
paragraphs.zh: 諾丁漢大學醫院國民保健署信託基金會（Nottingham University Hospitals NHS Trust）的顧問神經外科醫師史密斯（Stuart Smith）協助領導了該研究團隊。他解釋說，能在病患還在手術中時就掌握這些詳細資訊，對醫學界而言是具備顛覆性的時刻。他表示對團隊的成果感到非常自豪，特別是因為這能幫助那些沒有太多時間等待結果的病患。這種速度也意味著部分病患能比以往更早參與臨床試驗，即測試新療法的特殊研究計畫。

paragraphs.en: NHS England has already started using this new tool. According to The Guardian Health, the NHS is currently testing the method in five specialist centres across the country. These locations include Nottingham University Hospitals, University Hospitals Birmingham, Great Ormond Street Hospital, King’s College Hospital, and Newcastle Hospitals. Following this initial pilot phase, the plan is to bring the technology to other major cities, including Bristol, Oxford, Leeds, and Manchester.
paragraphs.zh: 英國國民保健署（NHS）已開始使用這項新工具。根據《衛報健康》報導，國民保健署目前正在全國五個專科中心測試此方法。這些地點包括諾丁漢大學醫院、伯明罕大學醫院、大奧蒙德街醫院、國王學院醫院以及紐卡索醫院。在初步試辦階段結束後，計畫將把這項技術推廣至布里斯托、牛津、里茲及曼徹斯特等其他主要城市。

paragraphs.en: Prof Frankie Swords, the NHS medical director, described the new test as a huge leap forward. She noted that it has the potential to completely change how brain tumours are diagnosed in the future. By removing the long wait for results, the NHS hopes to reduce the uncertainty that patients and their families face during such a difficult time.
paragraphs.zh: 國民保健署醫學主任史沃茲教授（Prof Frankie Swords）形容這項新檢測是一大躍進。她指出，這項技術有潛力徹底改變未來診斷腦瘤的方式。透過消除漫長的等待時間，國民保健署希望能減少病患及其家屬在如此艱難時刻所面臨的不確定感。

paragraphs.en: This update follows earlier reports on the development of the test, which highlighted the urgent need for faster diagnostic tools. As the NHS continues to roll out this technology, the medical community remains hopeful that it will become a standard part of brain surgery. While the pilot program is still in its early stages, the ability to make fast, evidence-based decisions during an operation marks a significant step forward in modern healthcare. By combining advanced genetic science with practical surgical needs, researchers are providing doctors with the tools they need to give patients the best possible chance of recovery.
paragraphs.zh: 這項更新延續了先前關於該檢測開發的報導，強調了對更快速診斷工具的迫切需求。隨著國民保健署持續推廣這項技術，醫學界仍抱持希望，期待它能成為腦部手術的標準配備。雖然試辦計畫仍處於早期階段，但在手術過程中做出快速且具科學依據的決策，標誌著現代醫療向前邁出了重要的一步。透過將先進的基因科學與實際的手術需求相結合，研究人員正為醫師提供所需的工具，以給予病患最佳的康復機會。

keyTerms.definitionEn: Having a significant effect on how a situation or process is done.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 改變遊戲規則的；具有重大影響的。
keyTerms.noteZh: 此詞常形容能徹底改變現狀的事物，而非字面上的遊戲。文中：He explained that having this detailed information while a patient is still in surgery is a game-changing moment for medicine.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To make a new product or service available for the first time.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 推出；施行（新計畫或產品）。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「滾動」，這裡指大規模推行新技術。文中：As the NHS continues to roll out this technology, the medical community remains hopeful that it will become a standard part of brain surgery.

keyTerms.definitionEn: A sudden and significant improvement or advancement.
keyTerms.noteZh: 字面意為「向前跳躍」，在此指技術上的重大突破。文中：Prof Frankie Swords, the NHS medical director, described the new test as a huge leap forward.

previousArticles.summaryEn: A new medical test is changing how doctors diagnose brain tumours. Developed by the University of Nottingham, the test provides results in two hours instead of eight weeks. It works by analyzing the genetic code of a tumour sample during surgery. The NHS is currently testing this tool in five specialist centres across the UK. Experts believe this technology will save lives by allowing for faster treatment decisions.

quiz.question: How does the new diagnostic method differ from the previous approach used to identify brain tumours?

options.A: It requires sending samples to five different specialist centres across the country.
options.B: It uses genomic testing to analyze the tumour's genetic code instead of relying solely on microscope examination.
options.C: It involves a two-hour waiting period after the surgery is completed to ensure accuracy.
options.D: It replaces the need for surgery by using non-invasive DNA scanning techniques.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第三段，舊的方法是透過顯微鏡觀察腫瘤樣本，而新的方法則是使用基因檢測（genomic test）來分析腫瘤的遺傳密碼。選項 A 錯誤，因為五個中心是指測試的試點地點，而非檢測流程的一部分。選項 C 錯誤，因為檢測是在手術台上進行，不需要術後等待。選項 D 錯誤，因為文章明確提到該技術是在手術過程中使用的，並非取代手術。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the impact of this new technology on patient treatment plans?

options.A: It guarantees that all patients will be cured of their brain tumours.
options.B: It forces patients to undergo more surgeries than they would have previously.
options.C: It allows doctors to make more timely decisions, potentially increasing access to clinical trials.
options.D: It eliminates the need for any further follow-up care after the initial surgery.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第四段，Stuart Smith 醫師提到這種快速診斷能讓患者更早參與臨床試驗（clinical trials），且能讓醫師在手術中做出基於證據的決定。選項 A 過於誇大，文章僅提到增加康復機會，並未保證治癒。選項 B 與文章內容矛盾，技術旨在提升效率而非增加手術次數。選項 D 錯誤，文章並未提到術後護理會被取消。

quiz.question: In the fourth paragraph, what does the phrase 'a game-changing moment' imply?

options.A: A situation that significantly alters the current way of doing things.
options.B: A moment of relaxation after a difficult surgical procedure.
options.C: A playful or lighthearted activity performed by the medical team.
options.D: A brief period where the surgery is paused for a team meeting.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在文中，「game-changing」形容這項技術對醫學領域產生了革命性的影響，徹底改變了診斷流程。選項 B 與文章強調的緊迫性和專業性不符。選項 C 將「game」誤解為遊戲，忽略了其在商業與科技語境中代表「改變規則」的慣用語。選項 D 錯誤，這並非指手術中的休息時間，而是指技術帶來的重大突破。

quiz.question: What is the primary message of this article?

options.A: The University of Nottingham is the only institution capable of performing genomic tests in the UK.
options.B: Brain tumours are becoming less common due to advancements in medical technology.
options.C: The NHS is planning to close several hospitals to focus on new diagnostic research.
options.D: A new, rapid genomic testing method is transforming brain tumour diagnosis by allowing for faster, more informed surgical decisions.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。全文的核心在於介紹這項新的基因檢測技術，強調它如何縮短診斷時間，讓醫師能在手術中做出即時決策，進而改善患者的治療預後。選項 A 錯誤，文章提到其他醫院也參與了試點計畫。選項 B 錯誤，文章並未提及腫瘤發生率下降。選項 C 錯誤，文中提到的是擴展技術至更多城市，而非關閉醫院。
